newsitem.title: USA: Fed stays out open market, RPs seen on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Fed stays out open market, RPs seen on Monday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve as expected refrained from intervening in the open market on Friday.

Analysts said that although the Fed faces around a $4.5 billion daily add need, Thursday's reserve add of $3.8 billion in four-day fixed system repurchase agreements took care of most of Friday's need.
But, they added, they Fed should be back in the market on Monday with a round of system RPs.
Federal funds were at 5-7/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target rate.
